algorithm: Key changes: 1) Increased base_target to better handle high-demand periods, 2) Reduced demand_response to be less reactive to spikes, 3) Removed lead_time_adjustment which wasn't helping (since lead time is fixed), 4) Added regime detection to adjust targets based on previous demand level, 5) Increased inventory_adjustment for faster replenishment. These changes better balance holding vs lost-sales costs given the demand patterns.
